hope: When you or an ally within Far range fails an action roll, spend 3 Hope to turn it into a success with Fear.

features.name: Hex
features.short: Mark a Stress to temporarily Hex a target within Far range. A Hexed target takes a penalty to damage rolls and Difficulty equal to your tier. You can Hex creatures up to your Spellcast trait at once.

features.name: Commune
features.short: Once per long rest, in a moment of calm, commune with an ancestor, deity, spirit, or otherworldly being. Ask a question, roll d6s equal to your Spellcast trait, and choose one result: 1–3 you taste, smell, or feel a sensation relevant to the answer; 4–5 you hear sounds or see a vision relevant to it; 6 you psychically experience a scene relevant to it as if there.

witch.hedge.name: Herbal Remedies
witch.hedge.short: When you or an ally in the scene clears Hit Points or Stress using a consumable, increase the amount cleared by 1.

witch.hedge.name: Enchanted Talisman
witch.hedge.short: Once per rest, imbue a small item: spend any number of Hope to place that many tokens on this card. When the holder takes damage, spend a token to reduce the Hit Points they mark by one. Clear all tokens when you rest.

witch.hedge.name: Walk Between Worlds
witch.hedge.short: In a moment of calm, make a Spellcast Roll (13). Once per rest, on a success, mark a Stress to step beyond the veil and converse with nearby spirits. Place tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card and remove one each time a spirit answers. When the last is removed or the scene ends, you return to where you left.

witch.hedge.name: Vexing Malison
witch.hedge.short: Advantage on attacks against Hexed creatures.

witch.hedge.name: Circle of Power
witch.hedge.short: Once per rest, mark a circle outlining a Very Close area around you and place tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. While in it, you and allies get +2 to damage thresholds, attack rolls, and Evasion. Remove a token each time you or an ally in it makes an action roll or evades an attack. It lasts until the last token is removed or you leave the circle.

witch.moon.name: Night’s Glamour
witch.moon.short: Spellcast Roll (13): Glamour yourself in a bewitching facade. While Glamoured, you have advantage on rolls that use your illusory appearance, and adversaries within Close range must mark a Stress to attack you. Unless you mark a Stress to maintain it, the Glamour drops when you mark a Hit Point or deal damage.

witch.moon.name: Moonbeam
witch.moon.short: Once per session, conjure a column of moonlight lighting the area within Close range until the scene ends. In it, you and allies get +1 to Spellcast Rolls and see through illusions.

witch.moon.name: Ire of Pale Light
witch.moon.short: When a Hexed creature within Very Far range fails an attack, it marks a Stress.

witch.moon.name: Lunar Phases
witch.moon.short: At the start of each session, roll a d6 and place it on this card for the matching effect until session end: 1 New: spend a Hope to negate Minor damage; 2–3 Waxing: +2 to damage rolls; 4 Full: +3 to damage thresholds; 5–6 Waning: +1 to Evasion. Once per rest, spend a Hope to raise the die by one (a 6 becomes a 1).
